english: Shade & other trees
afrikaans_before: Skadu- en ander bome

english: Staple garden
afrikaans_before: Stapeltuin

english: Fit map to view
afrikaans_before: Pas kaart by die aansig
back_translation: Fit map to the view

english: Base: {mode}. Switch base.
afrikaans_before: Basis: {mode}. Wissel basis.
back_translation: Base: {mode}. Switch base.

english: Base: {mode}. Switch to {next}.
afrikaans_before: Basis: {mode}. Wissel na {next}.
back_translation: Base: {mode}. Switch to {next}.

afrikaans_before: satelliet

english: photo
afrikaans_before: foto
back_translation: photo

english: drone photo

english: blank
afrikaans_before: leeg
back_translation: empty

english: Site not analysed yet — open this place on the map to fetch climate & slope, then redraw.
afrikaans_before: Terrein nog nie ontleed nie — maak hierdie plek op die kaart oop om klimaat en helling te haal, en teken dan weer.
back_translation: Site not yet analysed — open this place on the map to get climate and slope, and then draw again.

english: No terrain data yet — open this place on the map to fetch slope & aspect.
afrikaans_before: Nog geen terreindata nie — maak hierdie plek op die kaart oop om helling en aspek te haal.
back_translation: No terrain data yet — open this place on the map to get slope and aspect.

english: No wind/temperature data yet — open this place on the map to fetch climate.
afrikaans_before: Nog geen wind-/temperatuurdata nie — maak hierdie plek op die kaart oop om klimaat te haal.
back_translation: No wind/temperature data yet — open this place on the map to get climate.

english: No regional fire-wind pattern for this area — walk the boundary and ask neighbours which side fires come from.
afrikaans_before: Geen streekspatroon vir brandwind in hierdie gebied nie — stap die grens langs en vra bure uit watter kant brande kom.
back_translation: No regional pattern for fire wind in this area — walk along the boundary and ask neighbours which side fires come from.

english: Fire sector not shown: this site’s fire season doesn’t match the region’s sourced berg-wind pattern — confirm the fire approach locally before siting a firebreak.
afrikaans_before: Brandsektor nie gewys nie: hierdie terrein se brandseisoen stem nie ooreen met die streek se bergwindpatroon uit bronne nie — bevestig die brandrigting plaaslik voordat jy 'n brandstrook uitsit.
back_translation: Fire sector not shown: this site's fire season does not agree with the region's sourced berg-wind pattern — confirm the fire direction locally before you set out a firebreak.

english: Cold air settles in low spots on still, clear nights.
afrikaans_before: Koue lug sak in lae plekke op stil, helder nagte.
back_translation: Cold air sinks into low places on still, clear nights.

english: Local DEM relief is too small to confirm a downhill direction — use neighbouring contours or measure the fall on site.
afrikaans_before: Plaaslike DEM-reliëf is te klein om 'n afwaartse rigting te bevestig — gebruik naburige kontoere of meet die val op die terrein.
back_translation: Local DEM relief is too small to confirm a downward direction — use neighbouring contours or measure the fall on the site.

english: Already traced your fence line on the main map? You’re done. Otherwise tap "Do this" and trace the outer edge of your land here, corner to corner.
afrikaans_before: Het jy reeds jou heiningslyn op die hoofkaart getrek? Dan is jy klaar. Anders, tik "Doen dit" en trek hier die buitenste rand van jou grond, hoek tot hoek.
back_translation: Have you already drawn your fence line on the main map? Then you are done. Otherwise, tap "Do it" and draw the outer edge of your land here, corner to corner.

english: The outer edge of your land, corner to corner.
afrikaans_before: Die buitenste rand van jou grond, hoek tot hoek.
back_translation: The outer edge of your land, corner to corner.

english: Mark your house
afrikaans_before: Merk jou huis
back_translation: Mark your house

english: Tap "Do this", then trace around your house roof on the map.
afrikaans_before: Tik "Doen dit" en trek dan rondom jou huis se dak op die kaart.
back_translation: Tap "Do it" and then draw around your house's roof on the map.

english: The building you live in — tanks and Zone 1 go closest to it.
afrikaans_before: Die gebou waarin jy woon — tenks en Sone 1 kom die nouste daaraan.
back_translation: The building you live in — tanks and Zone 1 go closest to it.

english: Mark paving & driveway
afrikaans_before: Merk plaveisel en oprit
back_translation: Mark paving and driveway

english: Trace hard surfaces — the driveway, yard paving, or a concrete slab.
afrikaans_before: Trek harde oppervlakke — die oprit, werfplaveisel of 'n betonblad.
back_translation: Draw hard surfaces — the driveway, yard paving or a concrete slab.

english: Anywhere rain runs straight off instead of soaking in.
afrikaans_before: Enige plek waar reën reguit afloop in plaas daarvan om in te trek.
back_translation: Any place where rain runs straight off instead of soaking in.

english: Mark existing lawn, veg or orchard
afrikaans_before: Merk bestaande gras, groente of vrugteboord
back_translation: Mark existing lawn, vegetables or orchard

english: Trace the ground you already use — a lawn, an old veg patch, existing trees.
afrikaans_before: Trek die grond wat jy reeds gebruik — 'n grasperk, 'n ou groenteland, bestaande bome.
back_translation: Draw the ground you already use — a lawn, an old vegetable plot, existing trees.

english: What’s already growing, so your plan builds on it.
afrikaans_before: Wat reeds groei, sodat jou plan daarop bou.
back_translation: What is already growing, so that your plan builds on it.

english: Find the sun arc — your beds want the northern sun
afrikaans_before: Vind die sonboog — jou beddings wil die noordelike son hê
back_translation: Find the sun arc — your beds want the northern sun

english: The gold arc across the top of the map is the sun. In South Africa it swings across the NORTH, so that side gets the most light.
afrikaans_before: Die goue boog bo-aan die kaart is die son. In Suid-Afrika swaai dit oor die NOORDE, so daardie kant kry die meeste lig.
back_translation: The golden arc at the top of the map is the sun. In South Africa it swings across the NORTH, so that side gets the most light.

english: Face your veg beds and tender crops toward the sun side — the north.
afrikaans_before: Draai jou groentebeddings en koueskuwe gewasse na die sonkant — die noorde.
back_translation: Turn your vegetable beds and cold-sensitive crops towards the sun side — the north.

english: Note the fire wedge — plan a firebreak/low fuel on that side
afrikaans_before: Let op die brandwig — beplan 'n brandstrook of min brandstof aan daardie kant
back_translation: Note the fire wedge — plan a firebreak or little fuel on that side

english: The red wedge points to where a veld fire is most likely to come from — the dry-season wind. If it is missing, your site has no wind data yet.
afrikaans_before: Die rooi wig wys waarvandaan 'n veldbrand heel waarskynlik sal kom — die droëseisoenwind. As dit ontbreek, het jou terrein nog geen winddata nie.
back_translation: The red wedge shows where a veld fire is most likely to come from — the dry-season wind. If it is missing, your site has no wind data yet.

english: Keep a firebreak clear and the fuel low on the fire side of your land.
afrikaans_before: Hou 'n brandstrook skoon en die brandstof laag aan die brandkant van jou grond.
back_translation: Keep a firebreak clear and the fuel low on the fire side of your land.

english: See the downhill water arrow — swales will go ACROSS it
afrikaans_before: Sien die pyl vir afwaartse water — kontoerslote kom DWARS daaroor
back_translation: See the arrow for downward water — contour swales go ACROSS it

english: The blue arrow shows which way water runs downhill. Swales and beds work best laid ACROSS that flow, not along it, so rain sinks in.
afrikaans_before: Die blou pyl wys in watter rigting water afloop. Kontoerslote en beddings werk die beste DWARS oor daardie vloei gelê, nie daarlangs nie, sodat reën kan intrek.
back_translation: The blue arrow shows in which direction water runs off downhill. Contour swales and beds work best laid ACROSS that flow, not along it, so rain can soak in.

english: Later, on the Water step, draw your swale lines across this arrow.
afrikaans_before: Later, by die Water-stap, trek jou kontoersloot-lyne oor hierdie pyl.
back_translation: Later, at the Water step, draw your swale lines across this arrow.

english: Add your rainwater tanks
afrikaans_before: Voeg jou reënwatertenks by
back_translation: Add your rainwater tanks

english: Tap a JoJo tank size, then tap the map next to a roof.
afrikaans_before: Tik 'n JoJo-tenkgrootte en tik dan op die kaart langs 'n dak.
back_translation: Tap a JoJo tank size and then tap on the map beside a roof.

english: Within 3 m of a roof downpipe, on level, compacted ground.
afrikaans_before: Binne 3 m van 'n dak se reënpyp, op gelyk, vasgetrapte grond.
back_translation: Within 3 m of a roof's rain pipe, on level, trampled-firm ground.

english: Mark your tap points
afrikaans_before: Merk jou kraanpunte
back_translation: Mark your tap points

english: Tap "Do this", then drop a tap point wherever you’ll fill a can or hose.
afrikaans_before: Tik "Doen dit" en plaas dan 'n kraanpunt waar jy 'n kan of slang gaan volmaak.
back_translation: Tap "Do it" and then place a tap point where you will fill a can or hose.

english: At bed corners — so a hose reaches without crossing a path.
afrikaans_before: By beddinghoeke — sodat 'n slang kan bykom sonder om oor 'n paadjie te gaan.
back_translation: At bed corners — so that a hose can reach without going across a path.

english: Draw swale lines across the slope
afrikaans_before: Trek kontoersloot-lyne dwars oor die helling
back_translation: Draw swale lines straight across the slope

english: Draw a line ACROSS the slope (on contour), not down it, so rain sinks in.
afrikaans_before: Trek 'n lyn DWARS oor die helling (op die kontoer), nie daarteen af nie, sodat reën kan intrek.
back_translation: Draw a line ACROSS the slope (on the contour), not down against it, so rain can soak in.
note: "nie daarteen af nie" is unidiomatic ("not down against it") but ACROSS (DWARS) is kept and the contrast is clear.

english: Along the hillside, level end to end — above your beds and trees.
afrikaans_before: Langs die bergkant, gelyk van punt tot punt — bo jou beddings en bome.
back_translation: Along the mountainside, level from end to end — above your beds and trees.
note: "bergkant" (mountain side) for "hillside"; direction (along the slope, level) intact.

english: Add drip or pipe lines
afrikaans_before: Voeg drup- of pyplyne by
back_translation: Add drip or pipe lines

english: Draw where water will travel — a drip line to the beds or a pipe from a tank.
afrikaans_before: Trek waar water gaan loop — 'n druplyn na die beddings of 'n pyp van 'n tenk.
back_translation: Draw where water will run — a drip line to the beds or a pipe from a tank.

english: Tank → beds, the shortest sensible run.
afrikaans_before: Tenk → beddings, die kortste sinvolle roete.
back_translation: Tank → beds, the shortest sensible route.

english: Add a pond or greywater basin
afrikaans_before: Voeg 'n dam of gryswaterkom by
back_translation: Add a pond or greywater basin

english: Optional: a pond in a low spot, or a greywater basin off the kitchen outlet.
afrikaans_before: Opsioneel: 'n dam in 'n lae plek, of 'n gryswaterkom by die kombuisuitlaat.
back_translation: Optional: a pond in a low place, or a greywater basin at the kitchen outlet.

english: Ponds in a natural low point; greywater by a fruit tree or banana.
afrikaans_before: Damme in 'n natuurlike lae punt; gryswater by 'n vrugteboom of piesang.
back_translation: Ponds at a natural low point; greywater at a fruit tree or banana.

english: Draw a line ACROSS the slope (on contour), not down it, so rain sinks in. Turn Contours on in Layers to see the lines to follow.
afrikaans_before: Trek 'n lyn DWARS oor die helling (op die kontoer), nie daarteen af nie, sodat reën kan intrek. Skakel Kontoere aan onder Lae om die lyne te sien wat jy moet volg.
back_translation: Draw a line ACROSS the slope (on the contour), not down against it, so rain can soak in. Switch Contours on under Layers to see the lines you must follow.
note: Same "daarteen af" wording as the row above; DWARS and the Contours-on instruction intact.

english: Build the berm on the downhill side
afrikaans_before: Bou die wal aan die afwaartse kant
back_translation: Build the bank/wall on the downhill side

english: The soil you dig out of a swale goes on its downhill lip. Place a berm there, then plant it.
afrikaans_before: Die grond wat jy uit 'n kontoersloot grawe, kom op sy afwaartse lip. Plaas daar 'n wal en plant dit dan.
back_translation: The soil you dig out of a contour swale goes on its downhill lip. Place a bank there and then plant it.

english: Directly below each swale — never above it.
afrikaans_before: Reg onder elke kontoersloot — nooit daarbo nie.
back_translation: Directly below each contour swale — never above it.

english: Terrace the steep ground
afrikaans_before: Maak terrasse van die steil grond
back_translation: Make terraces of the steep ground

english: On a slope too steep to plant across, cut level platforms with a bank between them.
afrikaans_before: Sny op 'n helling wat te steil is om dwarsoor te plant gelyk platforms met 'n wal tussen hulle.
back_translation: On a slope that is too steep to plant across, cut level platforms with a bank between them.

english: The steepest part of your land, where soil washes away now.
afrikaans_before: Die steilste deel van jou grond, waar grond nou wegspoel.
back_translation: The steepest part of your land, where soil is now washing away.

english: Add half-moons for single trees
afrikaans_before: Voeg halfmane by vir enkele bome
back_translation: Add half-moons for single trees

english: A half-moon is a small crescent bank that catches runoff for one tree. Good where a full swale is more digging than you need.
afrikaans_before: 'n Halfmaan is 'n klein sekelvormige wal wat afloop vir een boom vang. Goed waar 'n volle kontoersloot meer grawewerk is as wat jy nodig het.
back_translation: A half-moon is a small crescent-shaped bank that catches runoff for one tree. Good where a full contour swale is more digging than you need.

english: Uphill of a tree you want to keep alive through the dry season.
afrikaans_before: Bo-kant 'n boom wat jy deur die droë seisoen wil laat lewe.
back_translation: On the upper side of a tree you want to keep alive through the dry season.

english: Zone 1 — nearest the kitchen door
afrikaans_before: Sone 1 — die naaste aan die kombuisdeur
back_translation: Zone 1 — the closest to the kitchen door

english: Paint the area you can reach in about 20 steps from the door.
afrikaans_before: Verf die gebied wat jy in ongeveer 20 treë van die deur kan bereik.
back_translation: Paint the area you can reach in about 20 steps from the door.

english: Right around the house — herbs, salad, the things you pick daily.
afrikaans_before: Reg rondom die huis — kruie, slaai, die goed wat jy daagliks pluk.
back_translation: Right around the house — herbs, salad, the things you pick daily.

english: Zone 2 — your main veg beds
afrikaans_before: Sone 2 — jou hoofgroentebeddings
back_translation: Zone 2 — your main vegetable beds

english: Paint the next ring out — where the bulk of your vegetables grow.
afrikaans_before: Verf die volgende ring buitentoe — waar die meeste van jou groente groei.
back_translation: Paint the next ring outwards — where most of your vegetables grow.

english: A short walk from the door; visited most days.
afrikaans_before: 'n Kort entjie van die deur; die meeste dae besoek.
back_translation: A short stretch from the door; visited most days.

english: Zone 3 — orchard & food forest
afrikaans_before: Sone 3 — vrugteboord en voedselwoud
back_translation: Zone 3 — orchard and food forest

english: Paint where your fruit trees and bigger plots will live.
afrikaans_before: Verf waar jou vrugtebome en groter persele sal wees.
back_translation: Paint where your fruit trees and larger plots will be.

english: Further out — visited weekly, not daily.
afrikaans_before: Verder weg — weekliks besoek, nie daagliks nie.
back_translation: Further away — visited weekly, not daily.

english: Zone 4 / 5 — grazing & wild edge
afrikaans_before: Sone 4 / 5 — weiding en wilde rand
back_translation: Zone 4 / 5 — grazing and wild edge

english: Optional: paint low-care land — grazing, woodlot, or a wild buffer strip.
afrikaans_before: Opsioneel: verf grond wat min sorg nodig het — weiding, houtbos of 'n wilde buffer-strook.
back_translation: Optional: paint land that needs little care — grazing, woodlot or a wild buffer strip.

english: The outer edges you visit least.
afrikaans_before: Die buitenste rande wat jy die minste besoek.
back_translation: The outermost edges that you visit the least.

english: Place your fruit & nut trees first
afrikaans_before: Plaas eers jou vrugte- en neutebome
back_translation: Place your fruit and nut trees first

english: Trees are biggest and last longest — place them, then fit beds around them.
afrikaans_before: Bome is die grootste en hou die langste — plaas hulle eers en pas dan beddings rondom hulle in.
back_translation: Trees are the biggest and last the longest — place them first and then fit beds in around them.

english: South or west of veg beds (SA sun is in the north) so they don’t shade them. Give each its full-grown width.
afrikaans_before: Suid of wes van groentebeddings (SA se son is in die noorde) sodat hulle dit nie beskadu nie. Gee elkeen sy volle volwasse breedte.
back_translation: South or west of vegetable beds (SA's sun is in the north) so that they do not shade them. Give each its full grown width.

english: Add your vegetable beds
afrikaans_before: Voeg jou groentebeddings by
back_translation: Add your vegetable beds

english: Drop beds in full sun, within easy reach of a tap and the kitchen.
afrikaans_before: Plaas beddings in volle son, binne maklike bereik van 'n kraan en die kombuis.
back_translation: Place beds in full sun, within easy reach of a tap and the kitchen.

english: Open, sunny ground in Zone 1–2 — not under a tree canopy.
afrikaans_before: Oop, sonnige grond in Sone 1–2 — nie onder 'n boomkroon nie.
back_translation: Open, sunny ground in Zone 1–2 — not under a tree crown.

english: Add support planting
afrikaans_before: Voeg ondersteuningsaanplanting by
back_translation: Add support planting

english: Optional: pollinator strips, mulch banks, a banana circle — they feed the system.
afrikaans_before: Opsioneel: bestuiwerstroke, deklaagwalle, 'n piesangsirkel — hulle voed die stelsel.
back_translation: Optional: pollinator strips, mulch banks, a banana circle — they feed the system.

english: Pollinators along orchard edges; mulch banks beside the beds that need it.
afrikaans_before: Bestuiwers langs die vrugteboordrande; deklaagwalle langs die beddings wat dit nodig het.
back_translation: Pollinators along the orchard edges; mulch banks beside the beds that need it.

english: Set up compost
afrikaans_before: Rig kompos op
back_translation: Set up compost

english: Place a compost bay or worm farm on the path between kitchen and beds.
afrikaans_before: Plaas 'n komposbak of wurmplaas op die paadjie tussen kombuis en beddings.
back_translation: Place a compost bin or worm farm on the path between kitchen and beds.

english: On the way out with scraps, on the way in with finished compost.
afrikaans_before: Op pad uit met afval, op pad in met klaar kompos.
back_translation: On the way out with waste, on the way in with finished compost.

english: Place animal housing
afrikaans_before: Plaas dierebehuising
back_translation: Place animal housing

english: Optional: a chicken coop, kraal or pen — close enough for daily care, downwind of the house.
afrikaans_before: Opsioneel: 'n hoenderhok, kraal of kampie — naby genoeg vir daaglikse sorg, met die wind weg van die huis.
back_translation: Optional: a chicken coop, kraal or small camp — near enough for daily care, with the wind away from the house.
afrikaans_after: Opsioneel: 'n hoenderhok, kraal of kampie — naby genoeg vir daaglikse sorg, aan die kant waarheen die wind van die huis af waai.
note: Paired with the next row: "met die wind weg van die huis" was correct on a careful read, but is reworded to the same clear phrase as the downwind hint so the two rows cannot be read in opposite directions.

english: Downwind and a little downhill; manure feeds the compost.
afrikaans_before: Met die wind af en effens afdraand; mis voed die kompos.
back_translation: With the wind down and a little downhill; manure feeds the compost.
afrikaans_after: Aan die kant waarheen die wind van die huis af waai, en effens afdraand; mis voed die kompos.
note: "Met die wind af" ("with the wind down") does not clearly say downwind; a farmer could read it as "when the wind is low" or place the animals on the wrong side. Now says the side the wind blows towards from the house.

english: Add storage & work space
afrikaans_before: Voeg stoor- en werkruimte by
back_translation: Add storage and work space

english: Optional: a shed, nursery table or shade house near your main work zone.
afrikaans_before: Opsioneel: 'n skuur, kwekerytafel of skaduhuis naby jou hoofwerksone.
back_translation: Optional: a shed, nursery table or shade house near your main work zone.

english: By the beds you work most, out of the prevailing rain.
afrikaans_before: By die beddings waarmee jy die meeste werk, uit die heersende reën.
back_translation: By the beds you work with most, out of the prevailing rain.

english: Extras — beehive, bench, gate
afrikaans_before: Ekstras — byekorf, bank, hek
back_translation: Extras — beehive, bench/bank, gate
note: "bank" is both a bench and a financial bank in Afrikaans (false friend caught in earlier reviews); a garden bench is now "sitbank".

english: Optional: finishing touches. Mind the beehive flight path — keep it clear of foot traffic.
afrikaans_before: Opsioneel: afwerking. Let op die byekorf se vlugpad — hou dit vry van voetverkeer.
back_translation: Optional: finishing. Watch the beehive's flight path — keep it free of foot traffic.

english: Beehive facing east, well clear of paths; benches in the shade.
afrikaans_before: Byekorf wat ooswaarts kyk, ver van paadjies; banke in die skadu.
back_translation: Beehive that faces east, far from paths; benches/banks in the shade.
afrikaans_after: Byekorf wat ooswaarts kyk, ver van paadjies; sitbanke in die skadu.
note: Same false friend: "banke" now "sitbanke". Beehive facing east ("ooswaarts") and the clear-of-paths caveat intact.

english: Field blocks · {n}
afrikaans_before: Veldblokke · {n}
back_translation: Field blocks · {n}

english: Draw a field, then fill it with beds or keep it as open growing ground.
afrikaans_before: Trek 'n veld en vul dit dan met beddings of hou dit as oop groeigrond.
back_translation: Draw a field and then fill it with beds or keep it as open growing ground.
note: "veld" is the app-wide draft for a field block (veldbesoek, Veldjoernaal) and can also mean open veld; context (beds, growing ground) resolves it. A fluent reviewer may prefer "land" across the app.

english: Draw field polygon
afrikaans_before: Trek veldpoligoon
back_translation: Draw field polygon

english: Field block
afrikaans_before: Veldblok
back_translation: Field block

english: Field {n}
afrikaans_before: Veld {n}
back_translation: Field {n}

english: Select a field
afrikaans_before: Kies 'n veld
back_translation: Choose a field

english: Field name
afrikaans_before: Veldnaam
back_translation: Field name

english: Growing layout
afrikaans_before: Groei-uitleg
back_translation: Growing layout

english: Fill with beds
afrikaans_before: Vul met beddings
back_translation: Fill with beds

english: Open field (no beds)
afrikaans_before: Oop veld (geen beddings)
back_translation: Open field (no beds)

english: Bed length (m)
afrikaans_before: Beddinglengte (m)
back_translation: Bed length (m)

english: Bed width (m)
afrikaans_before: Beddingbreedte (m)
back_translation: Bed width (m)

english: Path width (m)
afrikaans_before: Paadjiebreedte (m)
back_translation: Path width (m)

english: Direction (degrees)
afrikaans_before: Rigting (grade)
back_translation: Direction (degrees)

english: The polygon becomes one field-sized crop-planning area.
afrikaans_before: Die poligoon word een veldgrootte gewasbeplanningsarea.
back_translation: The polygon becomes one field-size crop planning area.

english: {n} full-size beds fit. Paths separate rows and bed ends; unused edges stay unplanted. 0° runs east–west on the map.

english: Start with what's true
afrikaans_before: Begin met wat waar is
back_translation: Begin with what is true

english: Before you design anything, get the real picture: your boundary, your house, and what's already on the ground. Everything you place later is measured against these. If the base is wrong, every distance in your plan is wrong too.
afrikaans_before: Voordat jy iets ontwerp, kry die regte prentjie: jou grens, jou huis en wat reeds op die grond is. Alles wat jy later plaas, word hieraan gemeet. As die basis verkeerd is, is elke afstand in jou plan ook verkeerd.
back_translation: Before you design anything, get the real picture: your boundary, your house and what is already on the ground. Everything you place later is measured against this. If the base is wrong, every distance in your plan is wrong too.

english: Observe and interact — good design starts by seeing what's really there.
afrikaans_before: Neem waar en tree in wisselwerking — goeie ontwerp begin deur te sien wat werklik daar is.
back_translation: Observe and interact — good design begins by seeing what is really there.

english: Trace your boundary on the main map first — the Studio fits your satellite photo to it, so every bed you place is true to scale.
afrikaans_before: Teken eers jou grens op die hoofkaart — die Studio pas jou satellietfoto daarop aan, sodat elke bedding wat jy plaas, op skaal is.
back_translation: First draw your boundary on the main map — the Studio fits your satellite photo to it, so that every bed you place is to scale.

english: Read the land's energies
afrikaans_before: Lees die grond se kragte
back_translation: Read the land's forces

english: Before you place a single thing, see how sun, wind, fire and water may move across your land. The app computes sun, slope, drainage and traced access for this property, and adds clearly marked regional wind and fire context. Design WITH these energies, not against them: put windbreaks against the hot wind, a firebreak on the fire side, swales across the way water runs, and keep tender crops out of frost pockets. In South Africa the strongest sun usually comes from the north. Confirm the regional wind and fire assumptions with your own observations or a local expert before you build.
afrikaans_before: Voordat jy 'n enkele ding plaas, kyk hoe son, wind, vuur en water oor jou grond kan beweeg. Die toep bereken son, helling, dreinering en geteekende toegang vir hierdie eiendom, en voeg duidelik gemerkte streeksagtergrond oor wind en vuur by. Ontwerp MET hierdie kragte, nie daarteen nie: sit windskerms teen die warm wind, 'n vuurbreek aan die kant waar vuur kom, kontoerslote dwars oor die rigting waarin water loop, en hou sagte gewasse weg van ryp-kolle. In Suid-Afrika kom die sterkste son gewoonlik uit die noorde. Bevestig die streeksaannames oor wind en vuur met jou eie waarnemings of 'n plaaslike kenner voordat jy bou.
back_translation: Before you place a single thing, look at how sun, wind, fire and water may move across your land. The app calculates sun, slope, drainage and drawn access for this property, and adds clearly marked regional background on wind and fire. Design WITH these forces, not against them: put windbreaks against the hot wind, a firebreak on the side where fire comes from, contour swales across the direction in which water runs, and keep tender crops away from frost spots. In South Africa the strongest sun usually comes from the north. Confirm the regional assumptions about wind and fire with your own observations or a local expert before you build.

english: Design from patterns to details — read the big forces first, then place the small things.
afrikaans_before: Ontwerp van patrone na besonderhede — lees eers die groot kragte en plaas dan die klein dinge.
back_translation: Design from patterns to details — first read the big forces and then place the small things.

english: Fire comes from the dry-season wind — keep the fuel low and a firebreak clear on that side of your land.
afrikaans_before: Vuur kom met die wind van die droë seisoen — hou die brandstof laag en 'n vuurbreek oop aan daardie kant van jou grond.
back_translation: Fire comes with the wind of the dry season — keep the fuel low and a firebreak open on that side of your land.

english: Water first, everything else second
afrikaans_before: Water eerste, alles anders tweede
back_translation: Water first, everything else second

english: Water is the heaviest thing to move and the first thing to run out. Catch it where it falls: tanks next to roofs, and swale lines across the slope, on contour, so rain sinks into your soil instead of washing away. A garden planned around water survives a dry month; one without doesn't.
afrikaans_before: Water is die swaarste ding om te verskuif en die eerste ding wat opraak. Vang dit waar dit val: tenks langs dakke, en kontoerslote dwars oor die helling, op kontoer, sodat reën in jou grond insypel in plaas van weg te spoel. 'n Tuin wat rondom water beplan is, oorleef 'n droë maand; een sonder dit nie.
back_translation: Water is the heaviest thing to move and the first thing to run out. Catch it where it falls: tanks beside roofs, and contour swales across the slope, on the contour, so that rain seeps into your soil instead of washing away. A garden planned around water survives a dry month; one without it does not.

english: Catch and store energy — harvest rain in the wet season, spend it in the dry.
afrikaans_before: Vang en berg energie — oes reën in die nat seisoen en gebruik dit in die droë seisoen.
back_translation: Catch and store energy — harvest rain in the wet season and use it in the dry season.

english: Place a tank within 3 m of a roof downpipe. Every 10 mm of rain on a 100 m² roof gives you about 1,000 litres.
afrikaans_before: Plaas 'n tenk binne 3 m van 'n dakreënpyp. Elke 10 mm reën op 'n dak van 100 m² gee jou ongeveer 1 000 liter.
back_translation: Place a tank within 3 m of a roof rain pipe. Every 10 mm of rain on a roof of 100 m² gives you about 1 000 litres.

english: Shape the land once
afrikaans_before: Vorm die grond net een keer
back_translation: Shape the land only once

english: Earthworks are the slowest thing to undo, and the first thing a machine should do while it can still reach the ground: swales dug along the contour, berms built from what comes out of them, terraces and banks cut into a slope. Get the levels right and every rain afterwards works for you — water walks slowly across your land instead of running off it. Get them wrong and you have moved a great deal of soil into the wrong place.
afrikaans_before: Grondwerke is die stadigste ding om ongedaan te maak, en die eerste ding wat 'n masjien moet doen solank dit nog by die grond kan kom: kontoerslote wat langs die kontoer gegrawe word, walle gebou met wat daaruit kom, terrasse en walle wat in 'n helling gesny word. Kry die vlakke reg en elke reën daarna werk vir jou — water stap stadig oor jou grond in plaas van daarvan af te hardloop. Kry dit verkeerd en jy het baie grond na die verkeerde plek verskuif.
back_translation: Earthworks are the slowest thing to undo, and the first thing a machine must do as long as it can still get to the ground: contour swales dug along the contour, banks built with what comes out of them, terraces and banks cut into a slope. Get the levels right and every rain afterwards works for you — water walks slowly across your land instead of running off it. Get it wrong and you have moved a lot of soil to the wrong place.

english: Work with nature, not against it — follow the contour the land already has.
afrikaans_before: Werk saam met die natuur, nie daarteen nie — volg die kontoer wat die grond reeds het.
back_translation: Work together with nature, not against it — follow the contour that the land already has.

english: Set your levels along the contour before you dig, and plant the bank as soon as it is shaped — a bare berm is the first thing a big rain takes away.
afrikaans_before: Bepaal jou vlakke langs die kontoer voordat jy grawe, en plant die wal sodra dit gevorm is — 'n kaal wal is die eerste ding wat 'n groot reën wegvat.
back_translation: Fix your levels along the contour before you dig, and plant the bank as soon as it is formed — a bare bank is the first thing a big rain carries away.

english: Put things where your feet already go
afrikaans_before: Sit dinge waar jou voete reeds loop
back_translation: Put things where your feet already go

english: Zones plan your energy, not just your space. Things you visit every day — herbs, veg beds, chickens — belong nearest the kitchen door. Things you visit weekly or monthly go further out. This one idea cuts real walking time over a season, and keeps your most-tended plants where you will actually notice if they need water.
afrikaans_before: Sones beplan jou energie, nie net jou ruimte nie. Dinge wat jy elke dag besoek — kruie, groentebeddings, hoenders — hoort die naaste aan die kombuisdeur. Dinge wat jy weekliks of maandeliks besoek, gaan verder weg. Hierdie een idee verminder werklike looptyd oor 'n seisoen en hou jou mees versorgde plante waar jy sal opmerk as hulle water nodig het.
back_translation: Zones plan your energy, not just your space. Things you visit every day — herbs, vegetable beds, chickens — belong closest to the kitchen door. Things you visit weekly or monthly go further away. This one idea reduces real walking time over a season and keeps your most tended plants where you will notice if they need water.

english: Zone planning — the more often you use it, the closer it lives.
afrikaans_before: Sone-beplanning — hoe dikwelder jy dit gebruik, hoe nader is dit.
back_translation: Zone planning — the more often you use it, the closer it is.

english: Stand at your kitchen door and count 20 steps. What you can reach is Zone 1 — keep your daily harvest inside it.
afrikaans_before: Staan by jou kombuisdeur en tel 20 treë. Wat jy kan bereik, is Sone 1 — hou jou daaglikse oes daarbinne.
back_translation: Stand at your kitchen door and count 20 steps. What you can reach is Zone 1 — keep your daily harvest inside it.

english: Right plant, right place
afrikaans_before: Regte plant, regte plek
back_translation: Right plant, right place

english: Trees are the biggest, longest-living things you'll place — position them first and fit beds around them. In South Africa the midday sun sits in the north, so a tall tree on the north side of a bed steals its light. Give every fruit tree room for its full-grown size, not its seedling size.
afrikaans_before: Bome is die grootste, langslewende dinge wat jy sal plaas — plaas hulle eerste en pas beddings rondom hulle in. In Suid-Afrika staan die middagson in die noorde, so 'n hoë boom aan die noordekant van 'n bedding steel sy lig. Gee elke vrugteboom plek vir sy volgroeide grootte, nie sy saailinggrootte nie.
back_translation: Trees are the biggest, longest-living things you will place — place them first and fit beds in around them. In South Africa the midday sun stands in the north, so a tall tree on the north side of a bed steals its light. Give every fruit tree room for its full-grown size, not its seedling size.

english: Use and value diversity — a mix of trees, beds and flowers confuses pests and feeds bees.
afrikaans_before: Gebruik en waardeer diversiteit — 'n mengsel van bome, beddings en blomme verwar plae en voed bye.
back_translation: Use and value diversity — a mixture of trees, beds and flowers confuses pests and feeds bees.

english: Plant tall trees on the south or west of veg beds so winter sun still reaches them. A mango grows 10 m wide — measure that out before you dig.
afrikaans_before: Plant hoë bome aan die suide- of westekant van groentebeddings sodat winterson hulle steeds bereik. 'n Mango word 10 m breed — meet dit uit voordat jy grawe.
back_translation: Plant tall trees on the south or west side of vegetable beds so that winter sun still reaches them. A mango becomes 10 m wide — measure that out before you dig.

english: Buildings must work for the land
afrikaans_before: Geboue moet vir die grond werk
back_translation: Buildings must work for the land

english: Sheds, coops and kraals are workers, not furniture: a roof catches water, a wall blocks wind, animals make manure for your compost. Place each structure where what it produces feeds the next thing along.
afrikaans_before: Skure, hoenderhokke en kraale is werkers, nie meubels nie: 'n dak vang water, 'n muur keer wind, diere maak mis vir jou kompos. Plaas elke struktuur waar wat dit lewer die volgende ding voed.
back_translation: Sheds, chicken coops and kraals are workers, not furniture: a roof catches water, a wall stops wind, animals make manure for your compost. Place each structure where what it yields feeds the next thing.

english: Integrate rather than segregate — place things so they help each other.
afrikaans_before: Integreer eerder as om te skei — plaas dinge sodat hulle mekaar help.
back_translation: Integrate rather than separate — place things so that they help each other.

english: Put the compost bay on the path between kitchen and veg beds — scraps in on the way out, finished compost back on the way in.
afrikaans_before: Sit die kompostbak op die paadjie tussen die kombuis en die groentebeddings — afval in op pad uit, klaar kompos terug op pad in.
back_translation: Put the compost bin on the path between the kitchen and the vegetable beds — waste in on the way out, finished compost back on the way in.

english: Look before you build
afrikaans_before: Kyk voordat jy bou
back_translation: Look before you build

english: Walk through your design like a real morning: fetch water, feed the chickens, pick spinach. Are the paths short? Does anything shade the beds or block the tap? Changing it on the map costs nothing — changing it after digging costs a season.
afrikaans_before: Loop deur jou ontwerp soos 'n regte oggend: haal water, voer die hoenders, pluk spinasie. Is die paadjies kort? Gee iets skaduwee op die beddings of blokkeer dit die kraan? Om dit op die kaart te verander kos niks — om dit ná die grawe te verander kos 'n seisoen.
back_translation: Walk through your design like a real morning: fetch water, feed the chickens, pick spinach. Are the paths short? Does anything give shade on the beds or block the tap? Changing it on the map costs nothing — changing it after the digging costs a season.

english: Apply self-regulation and accept feedback — check the plan before the spade hits the ground.
afrikaans_before: Reguleer jouself en aanvaar terugvoer — gaan die plan na voordat die graaf die grond tref.
back_translation: Regulate yourself and accept feedback — check the plan before the spade/digger hits the ground.

english: Show the design to one other person. A mentor sees in one minute what you've stopped noticing.
afrikaans_before: Wys die ontwerp vir een ander persoon. 'n Mentor sien in een minuut wat jy opgehou het om raak te sien.
back_translation: Show the design to one other person. A mentor sees in one minute what you have stopped noticing.
